entries.reasoning: Indus Valley Co-operative Bank Limited is an RBI-licensed cooperative bank in India, fitting the definition of Regulated Lender. The proposed scope includes developing a Credit Early Warning System (EWS) and delinquency-prediction model, directly matching the restricted services during the 24-month cooling-off period following Lumen Final Acceptance on 31 July 2026.

incomingClauses.quote: Pursuant to its RFP No. IVCB/IT/2026/14 dated 2 September 2026, the Bank has selected the Service Provider to implement a Credit Early Warning System (EWS) for its MSME, gold-loan and retail loan portfolios, in line with RBI expectations on early identification of stressed assets.
develop early-warning signals and a delinquency-prediction model (30/60/90 DPD);
The Service Provider represents that it is not party to any agreement that restricts it from performing the Services, and that its performance will not breach any obligation owed to a third party.

entries.suggestedChange: Seek a written waiver from Lumen Small Finance Bank Ltd for this engagement, or consult legal counsel regarding the timeline constraints.
entries.waiverWhy: No written waiver was obtained from Lumen Small Finance Bank Ltd prior to proposal submission as required under Clause 10.3 of the Lumen MSA.
entries.impact: Collides with the Lumen non-compete commitment, which runs for 24 months from 31 July 2026 through 31 July 2028.
